texto:
Online learning is becoming more popular every day. Many students now choose to take courses on the internet instead of going to a traditional classroom. One of the biggest advantages is flexibility. Students can study at any time and from any place, like their home or a coffee shop. This is very helpful for people who have jobs or families. They can create their own study schedule that fits their life.

However, online learning is not for everyone. It requires a lot of self-discipline. In a traditional school, a teacher tells you when to do your work. When you study online, you are responsible for managing your own time. You need a good computer and a reliable internet connection. Without these tools, it can be very difficult to complete your assignments and communicate with your instructor. Online education is a great option, but it is important to be prepared for its unique challenges.

preguntas.pregunta: According to the text, what is a major advantage of online learning?

opciones.A: It is always easier than traditional classes.
opciones.B: It provides a flexible schedule for students.
opciones.C: Students get more direct attention from teachers.
opciones.D: It does not require a computer or internet.
opciones.E: All online courses are free of charge.

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es B porque el texto menciona explícitamente la flexibilidad como un beneficio principal. The text states, 'One of the biggest advantages is flexibility' and that students 'can create their own study schedule'. Las otras opciones son incorrectas: A es falsa, ya que el texto menciona 'unique challenges'; D es incorrecta porque el texto dice que necesitas 'a good computer and a reliable internet connection'; y C y E no se mencionan en el texto.

preguntas.pregunta: From the text, we can infer that a successful online student probably is...

opciones.A: someone who prefers to work in large groups.
opciones.B: someone who does not have a job.
opciones.E: a student who needs constant reminders from teachers.

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es C. El texto no lo dice directamente, pero se puede deducir. It says that online learning 'requires a lot of self-discipline' and that 'you are responsible for managing your own time'. Estas cualidades describen a una persona organizada e independiente. The other options are incorrect. Option E contradicts the idea of self-discipline. Option B is wrong because the text says online learning is helpful for 'people who have jobs'. Options A and D are not supported by the text.
